title: TOP AUXILIARY SIDE DOOR GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Convertible (19467) with the C07 auxiliary removable hardtop: 21-step factory procedure for fitting the hardtop and adjusting the door glass to seal against the windshield-side and roof-side weatherstrips. Covers hardtop positioning and mounting brackets, cementing the windshield-side weatherstrip, and setting the glass guide cams, idler cams, anti-rattle cushions and up/down stops, then rechecking after the body is mounted to the frame.
notes: (On Trim Line Before Body Drop)
1. Place the removable hardtop on the body; leave the header guide pin screws loose.
2. Locate the roof panel so the front drip molding's front edge sits about .50 behind, and parallel to, the w/shield reveal molding's front corner (Section B-B).
3. Drill for and mount the two hardtop brackets onto the folding top compartment lid. Keep a .10 to .20 in. gap between the roof panel's lower edge and the body's mating surface (Sections E-E, F-F).
4. Fit the three rear hardtop attachments; torque them.
5. Unlatch the folding top compartment lid and raise the top off the w/shield header. Torque the header guide pin screws. (Keep the roof raised until step 13 is done.)
6. Fit the w/shield side w/strip retainer; start only its lower two screws "A", loose.
7. Glue the w/shield side w/strip into the retainer, its top trim line flush to the corner header molding's upper outer corner. Keep cement off the back of the w/strip above the retainer.
8. Hang the side door glass and its related parts; leave the bolts into the door inner panel loose.
9. Raise the glass until its front upper corner sits about .50 in. under the header molding's front upper corner.
10. Slide the glass forward just enough to start it into the w/shield side w/strip retainer's groove.

11. At the belt line, press glass and w/strip retainer outboard until the glass's nylon stabilizer button meets the inner panel's wedge surface. Position the glass front edge engaged in, and parallel to, the w/strip (Section A-A). Torque: A. front guide cam upper bolts "B" (2); B. idler cam bolts "C" (2).
12. Press the front anti-rattle cushion outboard until it bears firmly on the glass; torque bolt "D".

13. Lower the glass to reach the retainer screws. Coat the w/strip's upper back surface with cement and place it on the body, its upper end flush with the header molding's upper corner. Through the w/strip's clearance hole, drill the mounting hole in the birdcage. Torque all three screws "A". Lower the roof back onto the header and close the header locks.

14. Set the glass up-position to get the glass-to-w/strip height shown in Section C-C. While setting height, shift the glass fore/aft as needed to keep its fit to the w/shield side w/strip (Section A-A). Torque the three screws "F".
15. Bring the front and rear upper stops against the window rollers; torque both screws "E".
16. Lower the glass until its top edge sits flush with the door outer panel. Bring the lower stop against the roller and torque both screws "H".

17. Raise the glass and move the rear guide cam in or out at the belt line to bring the glass rear edge as near as you can to the Section D-D relationship. Torque: A. rear guide cam lower bolt "G"; B. rear guide cam upper bolts "B" (2).
18. Press the rear anti-rattle cushion outboard until it bears firmly on the glass; torque bolt "D".
(After Body Drop)
19. Check door-to-body fit and lock-to-striker alignment; fix any misalignment caused by mounting the body on the frame.

20. Recheck that the glass front edge is parallel to and engaged in the w/shield side w/strip, in case body mounting threw it off. If not, loosen bolts "C" (2) and bolts "F" (3), reset per Section A-A, and retorque.
21. Move the roof panel side w/strip assemblies in or out for the seal interference shown in Sections C-C and D-D; torque the w/strip bolts.
NOTE See UPC 1 Doors.
notes_internal: Text-only page: no drawing, no torque legend, no callouts. Sections A-A to F-F and the specified torques are on other C07 sheets (presumably the drawing sheets), not here.
The page abbreviates windshield/weatherstrip with a slash ('w/shield', 'w/strip') that often prints as 'w.' or 'w ' in the scan; normalized to 'w/shield' and 'w/strip'.
Lettered fasteners "A"-"H" are not item numbers; summarized in the FASTENER LETTERS table from the step text.
